# Standards and models

> Part of the [Psychoacoustic Metrics Index](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/), an index of open-source implementations of psychoacoustic metrics. Data as of 2026-10-06. Web page: https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/standards.html

Every document the index refers to, newest first. Each implementation in the index is tied to one of these editions.

## Standards and regulations

| Date | Document | Title | Status | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-04 | [ISO/AWI 26573](https://www.iso.org/standard/93922.html) | Acoustics — Procedures for assessment and prediction of noise-induced perceptual annoyance through laboratory-based listening tests | in development | [Psychoacoustic annoyance](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/psychoacoustic-annoyance.html) |
| 2025-06 | [ECMA-418-2:2025 (4th ed.)](https://ecma-international.org/wp-content/uploads/ECMA-418-2_4th_edition_june_2025.pdf) | Psychoacoustic metrics for ITT equipment — Part 2 (methods for describing human perception based on the Sottek Hearing Model) | current | [Sottek Hearing Model loudness](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/loudness-ecma-418-2.html), [Sottek Hearing Model roughness](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/roughness-ecma-418-2.html), [Sottek Hearing Model fluctuation strength](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/fluctuation-strength-ecma-418-2.html), [Sottek Hearing Model tonality](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/tonality-ecma-418-2.html) |
| 2024-12 | [ECMA-418-2:2024 (3rd ed.)](https://ecma-international.org/wp-content/uploads/ECMA-418-2_3rd_edition_december_2024.pdf) | Psychoacoustic metrics for ITT equipment — Part 2 (methods for describing human perception based on the Sottek Hearing Model) | superseded | [Sottek Hearing Model loudness](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/loudness-ecma-418-2.html), [Sottek Hearing Model roughness](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/roughness-ecma-418-2.html), [Sottek Hearing Model tonality](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/tonality-ecma-418-2.html) |
| 2024-12 | [ECMA-418-1:2024 (3rd ed.)](https://ecma-international.org/wp-content/uploads/ECMA-418-1_3rd_edition_december_2024.pdf) | Psychoacoustic metrics for ITT equipment — Part 1 (prominent discrete tones) | current | [Tone-to-noise ratio and prominence ratio](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/tone-to-noise-prominence-ratio.html) |
| 2024-11 | [ISO/CD 532-3](https://www.iso.org/standard/90816.html) | Acoustics — Methods for calculating loudness — Part 3: Moore-Glasberg-Schlittenlacher method (2nd edition) | in development | [Time-varying loudness (Moore–Glasberg–Schlittenlacher)](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/loudness-moore-glasberg-time-varying.html) |
| 2024-11 | [ISO/CD 532-2](https://www.iso.org/standard/90812.html) | Acoustics — Methods for calculating loudness — Part 2: Moore-Glasberg method (2nd edition) | in development | [Moore–Glasberg loudness](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/loudness-moore-glasberg.html) |
| 2024-11 | [ISO/CD 532-1](https://www.iso.org/standard/90809.html) | Acoustics — Methods for calculating loudness — Part 1: Zwicker method (2nd edition) | in development | [Zwicker loudness](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/loudness-zwicker.html) |
| 2024-11 | [DIN 38455:2024](https://www.dinmedia.de/en/standard/din-38455/376186532) | Berechnung der Hörempfindung Rauigkeit (Calculation of the auditory sensation of roughness) | current | [Roughness (DIN 38455)](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/roughness-din-38455.html) |
| 2023-07 | [ISO 532-3:2023](https://www.iso.org/standard/69856.html) | Acoustics — Methods for calculating loudness — Part 3: Moore-Glasberg-Schlittenlacher method | current | [Time-varying loudness (Moore–Glasberg–Schlittenlacher)](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/loudness-moore-glasberg-time-varying.html) |
| 2023-03 | [ISO 226:2023](https://www.iso.org/standard/83117.html) | Acoustics — Normal equal-loudness-level contours | current | [Equal-loudness contours](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/equal-loudness-contours.html) |
| 2022-12 | [ISO/TS 20065:2022](https://www.iso.org/standard/81518.html) | Acoustics — Objective method for assessing the audibility of tones in noise — Engineering method | current | [Audibility of tones in noise (ISO/TS 20065)](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/tonal-audibility-iso-20065.html) |
| 2022-12 | [ECMA-418-2:2022 (2nd ed.)](https://ecma-international.org/wp-content/uploads/ECMA-418-2_2nd_edition_december_2022.pdf) | Psychoacoustic metrics for ITT equipment — Part 2 (models based on human perception) | superseded | [Sottek Hearing Model loudness](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/loudness-ecma-418-2.html), [Sottek Hearing Model roughness](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/roughness-ecma-418-2.html), [Sottek Hearing Model tonality](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/tonality-ecma-418-2.html) |
| 2022-12 | [ECMA-418-1:2022 (2nd ed.)](https://ecma-international.org/wp-content/uploads/ECMA-418-1_2nd_edition_december_2022.pdf) | Psychoacoustic metrics for ITT equipment — Part 1 (prominent discrete tones) | superseded | [Tone-to-noise ratio and prominence ratio](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/tone-to-noise-prominence-ratio.html) |
| 2022-07 | [ISO/PAS 1996-3:2022](https://www.iso.org/standard/77035.html) | Acoustics — Description, measurement and assessment of environmental noise — Part 3: Objective method for the measurement of prominence of impulsive sounds and for adjustment of LAeq | current | [Impulse prominence](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/impulsiveness.html) |
| 2020-12 | [ECMA-418-2:2020 (1st ed.)](https://ecma-international.org/wp-content/uploads/ECMA-418-2_1st_edition_december_2020.pdf) | Psychoacoustic metrics for ITT equipment — Part 2 (models based on human perception) | superseded | [Sottek Hearing Model loudness](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/loudness-ecma-418-2.html), [Sottek Hearing Model roughness](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/roughness-ecma-418-2.html), [Sottek Hearing Model tonality](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/tonality-ecma-418-2.html) |
| 2020-12 | [ECMA-418-1:2020 (1st ed.)](https://ecma-international.org/wp-content/uploads/ECMA-418-1_1st_edition_december_2020.pdf) | Psychoacoustic metrics for ITT equipment — Part 1 (prominent discrete tones) | superseded | [Tone-to-noise ratio and prominence ratio](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/tone-to-noise-prominence-ratio.html) |
| 2019-12 | [ECMA-74:2019 (17th ed.)](https://ecma-international.org/publications-and-standards/standards/ecma-74/) | Measurement of airborne noise emitted by information technology and telecommunications equipment | superseded | [Sottek Hearing Model tonality](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/tonality-ecma-418-2.html), [Tone-to-noise ratio and prominence ratio](https://zhenxianli.github.io/psychoacoustic-metrics-index/metrics/tone-to-noise-prominence-ratio.html) |
